title: About Flashlit Release Shrine
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 547 recent saved-signal files and 80 captured links, then narrowed the page to 10 source windows around AVANTGAYNFTCOREPORTER (@avantgayALPHA) on X and Anchor image material 1, plus 8 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Flashlit Release Shrine: Flashlit release shrine, poster crop composition with browserless media-shrine grammar: a broad white page field holds one large centered landscape photo-slab, dark social masses facing inward across a glossy mahogany seam of drinks and bag-pattern fragments. Upper-center bar shelves and doorway apertures recede int... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 10 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against central flash-photo aperture, lower glossy cocktail-table seam, and bottom yellow emblem tab.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
